topic: Humming 3 of 3: For people who lose count
caption:
Lose count halfway through a breathing exercise? A hum can keep time for you.

Counting breaths takes attention, and some days there isn't much to spare. Humming tends to slow your breathing on its own: breathe in through your nose, then hum out until the sound fades. Not for you? A long, slow breath out works too. If you feel light-headed, stop and breathe normally.

Send this to someone who always loses count.

Part three of three on humming.
